title: Canada 2023
description: In March, four of us sojourned in Hilton Head Island. In the summer, we spent some time in Vancouver, B.C., Canada, hiked in Whistler, and perambulated around Victoria. In the winter, we visited the Biltmore estate in North Carolina. Shot on Pentax K-1000 (Kodak Ultramax 400, Portra 160, B&W Ilford 400).
